title: Identifying Immovable Obstructions
question: Which of the following is considered an immovable obstruction, entitling you to free relief under the Rules?

choices.text: A path with an artificial (man-made) surface
A pile of leaves gathered by the wind
A divot hole in the fairway

explanation: A path with a man-made surface is classed as an immovable obstruction. You are allowed free relief from it. The other options are either loose impediments, natural damage, or animal holes.
imagePrompt: A teenage girl golfer stands next to a paved pathway on the fairway, her ball lying beside it as she prepares to drop the ball for free relief.
imageAlt: Teen girl golfer next to an artificial-path taking free relief.

issues: The golfer's shorts appear navy but could be very slightly more distinctly navy to avoid ambiguity under some lighting.
imageVerification.repairPrompt: Ensure the golfer's shorts are a clearly visible navy colour, even in bright daylight. All other elements are accurate.
